assertion_analysis.fails_if: A reproducible candidate failure is passed to _land.
The refusal omits the added test id.
Serial comparison does not classify the added failure as real.
The base or candidate serial reruns produce a different three-run pattern.
The measurement records a primary revision other than the fixture main commit.
The measured candidate first parent is not the fixture main commit.
The measured candidate second parent is not the delivered worker head.
The candidate population log omits the failing id.
The refusal omits the candidate population log path.
A nonreproducing added failure prevents landing.
The accepted intermittent failure is not recorded as a flake.
The nonreproducing failure is incorrectly classified as a real regression.
A clean candidate prevents landing.
The population does not run in both main and merged-candidate trees.
The clean candidate acquires a real regression classification.
Candidate construction moves the primary checkout HEAD.
Candidate construction moves the worker checkout HEAD.
A failure already present on current main prevents landing.
The main population arm omits the shared failure id.
The candidate population arm omits the shared failure id.
A shared failure is unnecessarily rerun as an added id.
A shared failure is classified as a real added regression.
The test mutation skipping importer discovery still refuses the landing.
The test mutation still invokes the importer population.
Cached evidence for an older primary allows a newly failing candidate to land.
The new refusal omits the failure id.
The cached old primary stamp is reused after primary advances.
A reproducible failure does not initially refuse landing.
A prior refusal is not reconsidered after primary changes and the test runner becomes clean.
A population runner exit 2 is treated as a clean measurement and lands.
The refusal does not identify unreadable measurement output.
A primary move during measurement still permits landing.
A primary move is not reported as deferred.
An unreadable delivery diff allows landing.
The refusal does not identify the unreadable delivery diff.
The unreadable diff still starts a suite or population run.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares an observed result against the same value passed into the code under test; fixture main and head commits, runner outcomes, and recorded ids are independent reference values.

failure_evidence.baseline_note: The new test is absent at the base revision; the baseline log records a completed empty scope.

findings.text: blocking: The primary check is followed by a separate CLI merge at line 1344 whose command at line 973 omits the measured candidate; if primary advances in that interval, crew_run_commands.py:329 builds and lands a different unmeasured merge.

blocking: An implement run with no suite_command returns no measurement, _measure_guard accepts that absence, and the lander invokes the merge; the plan requires the importer population to be measured before landing.

non-blocking: delivered_paths duplicates reckon/clones.py:629's changed-path capability rather than extending its owner with a strict mode; folded into the candidate-handoff repair node so both callers share one reader with their required failure semantics.

item_verdicts.diff: I read commits 13d029a6be7f3b245ef03597d0a2ab44b17693e2, f680aa26a27fa48a5dd0efff6b2ffc1db886dfbf and 28d239f9b51f54d40a19b7e6a579fb7c84b1db47 against 5cb869148eacf537fd7e0a9845aeef7f83df2b08; the diff adds the candidate measure, focused tests and evidence fragment, but leaves the measured candidate out of the land command.
item_verdicts.done_when: Plan s29 at docs/plans/work-is-never-stuck-behind-the-admission-loop.html:237 asks for four outcomes and an importer-skip negative control; scoped-head.log records 10 passing cases and negative-control.log records the required failure, while the tests do not exercise the real merge handoff.
item_verdicts.goal: The source goal in prompt.txt:38 requires measurement before landing; queue_landing.py:1301 measures armed runs but queue_landing.py:773 skips unarmed ones and queue_landing.py:1344 does not pass the measured candidate.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md records three commits, 10 focused passes, 77 base and 77 head importer passes, and a red negative control; its scoped-base.log is explicitly an empty baseline because the new test did not exist there.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source prompt.txt:77-83 grants queue_landing.py, landing_measure.py, the new test and the evidence fragment; all four changed paths are granted.

justifications.durability: The independent fixture revisions and runner at tests/test_the_lander_measures_the_population.py:45-137 make population regressions fail, but no assertion catches the unarmed branch or a changed primary between queue_landing.py:1326 and its CLI merge.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_lander_measures_the_population.py:141-267 covers four requested outcomes and the recorded negative-control.log reddens the first case, but its stub at line 106 bypasses the real merge handoff.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:801-855 uses the surrounding Measurement and base_checkout flow, and the new source names describe their mechanisms.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1326 checks primary once before queue_landing.py:1344 starts a merge command that builds its own candidate, while queue_landing.py:773 skips measurement without a suite command.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:767 duplicates the git changed-path reader already owned by reckon/clones.py:629 instead of extending it with a strict failure mode, though candidate_checkout reuses merge.build_merge_commit and base_checkout.
justifications.scope_discipline: The four paths in the diff match source prompt.txt:77-83, including the permitted docs/evidence fragment.
